title: IFC-SIG-HALF-BLOCK-SHORT-CURRENT: consistent current blocked/typed compiler and joint n7 time proof

claims.statement: For everyN>=2,n=ceil(log2N), ONE current algorithm unconditionally outputs the ENTIREsecret s with probability>=2/3 under the explicitly declared independent ideal coset-source model. On MAINn>=2^48 the fully supplied SIG-HALF logical program has sigma1/2,alpha3037/5000,beta1923/12500,e279522669811793/181587148800000. Its actual physical bank uses EW=ceil(sqrt n),BL=NP(EW),NB=NP(ceil(WROW/BL)),VS=NP(BL+EW)=2BL,RS=NB*VS,WM=NP(2^16r),WROW=2^16n,ROWS=2^24*2^cb,OWN=2^16r,HQ=2^22r2^cb. EACH logical row has NB independently tagged BL-bit blocks; on every miss ALLBLvalues are actually cleared BEFORE publishing ALL EWtag bits, includingzero payloads. Actual RAW link/control fields and banked descriptors encode WM-bit SHORT identities; bindings have8WMbits; actualFRAMECAP8r,FS=NP((16+3*2^20)*WM) includesall unused captures/padding. LONG source P numeric fields,arithmetic/by-valuecopies and original bit expansion remain distinct. Source P fieldlocations/highlogicalzeros, injectiveSHORT identity/no-overflow and full decoded arbitrary-reference CQ law are explicitly proved. Every SHORT role/capture is fully overwritten before read. Current direct capture, virtualzero/canonicalalias, bind-before-individual-publication, unique lifetime lists, productive own-work event charging and whole-FWLEVEL no-group macro are completely specified and proved. Exact renumbering visits ALL blocks and preserves paused control, references and decoded values. For n<2^48 the fully supplied finite exhaustive source routine is executed, with its finite-resource/success proof; MAIN layout is not assumed at that branch. Current worst-case time T=O(n^7 2^(e sqrt n)),exact growthindex1/2,with nPower7,logPower0 andexponent coefficient e,nPower1/2,logPower0. Current literal cost T<=O(n C_P+n^2Qcap+sqrt n DRAW+poly(n))+T_renumber; C_P=O(n6exp(e sqrt n)),Qcap=O(n7/2exp(e sqrt n)),eachPbit/SHORTmetadata/wireevent costsO(n), source movesO(n²)percopy. No n^(3/2)per-event charge is used to infer n7. All initialization,address/gate generation,full physicalfee,failed/recycled/aborted paths,output-first reset/disposal and repeated exact maintenance are charged for this ONE current program. Allseven current mathematical files supply every obligation; no historical source guarantee or prior verdict is a premise.
